newsitem.title: GERMANY: VDA says German vehicle output stagnates in August.
newsitem.headline: VDA says German vehicle output stagnates in August.

text.p: German motor vehicle output stagnated at 280,100 units in August but rose three percent to 3.18 million units in the first eight months of the year, the German VDA Automobile Industry Association said on Tuesday.
Domestic orders for cars were unchanged in August over year-ago levels but foreign orders jumped 14 percent.
Car production in August edged up two percent to 258,400 units while commercial vehicle production dropped 14 percent to 21,700 units.
In the first eight months, car output rose three percent to 2.99 million units while commercial vehicle output fell three percent to 195,500 units, the VDA said.
Exports of motor vehicles fell six percent to 140,100 units in August but rose five percent to 1.82 million units in the first eight months, the VDA said.
Exports of cars fell six percent to 126,200 units but rose four percent to 1.70 million units during the first eight months of the year.
